title: Great for smaller sized warmers!
text: Great for smaller sized warmers!. A great value for the price! I use these in my warmer with wax melts. On the smaller side for tea lights, so each burns for about 2 hours...which is perfect for a smaller size warmer. Arrived quickly,  product as pictured.
